subject: Eval: Finova Labs discovery — align on trial & calendar
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Eval: Finova Labs discovery — align on trial & calendar

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to hear where Finova is prioritizing model-driven document extraction and how latency in the inference path impacts your user flows. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have shared expectations: 

- What we heard: focus on throughput for concurrent extraction jobs (batch > 50 concurrent users), strong accuracy on table extraction and named entities, and a hard production SLA requirement for 99.9% uptime.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 
  * Extraction precision >= 92% on your gold prompt set
  * Median inference latency under 350ms for single-document request
  * Clear audit logs + data retention controls for the pilot
- Our propose next step: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan) to outline the trial timeline, prompt set ingestion, and telemetry we will collect.

Available slots I can offer next week (PDT):
- Tue Apr 13, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Apr 14, 09:30–10:30 or 15:00–16:00

Deliverables we will bring to that call: a draft trial plan (timeline + milestones), suggested prompt / eval ingestion process, and preliminary infra/security checklist. If you can share your gold prompt set and any compliance contacts before the call (or attach here), it will help us prepare.

Attaching a one-page intake checklist and a draft trial plan we typically use for customers of this profile — we can customize during the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood_trial_plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@finova.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Eval: Finova Labs discovery — align on trial & calendar

Thanks Rafael — great summary. Tue Apr 13 at 14:00 PDT works for us (that’s 17:00 our time).

A couple clarifications on success criteria and prep: 
- Precision target: 92%+ on our current gold set — we’ll share an initial subset (20 documents) prior to the call.
- Latency: the 350ms median is a hard target for single-document calls; for batch jobs we can accept higher p95 but want to understand throughput limits.
- Security: we will need an initial SOC2/ISO sample and a contact for legal/infosec to run a short intake questionnaire.

Attaching the prompt examples we referenced (small set) and a short success-criteria doc — happy to expand after the kickoff.

Liam
Head of Engineering, Finova Labs
liam@finova.com

Attachments: finova_prompt_set_v1.txt (text, 20 prompts), trial_success_criteria.docx (docx)

Pre-kickoff asks so we hit the ground running: 
- Can you drop the 20-document gold subset into this shared folder or reply with the file? If possible include expected labels/fields we want extracted.
- Please share the name and email for your security/compliance reviewer (we’ll route our SOC2 artifact + short questionnaire to them before the call).

I’ll attach the updated trial plan after we incorporate your prompt set. Also copying Marissa (CS lead) and Neha (solutions architect) to help scope the technical deep dive and ensure we have an internal owner for prompt ingestion.
